subject: Next steps & stakeholder triage — calendar matrix
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@greenbank.com>, Alex Bowers <alex.bowers@greenbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: recap + next meeting proposal

Hi Samantha / Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost on your document search pipeline while keeping 95th percentile latency under 150ms for interactive queries.
- Constraints: strict audit logs, SSO via Okta, and procurement approval required for any third-party hosting.
- Success metric: integrate a pilot on 50k daily queries, validated by latency and cost delta over 2 weeks.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Technical deep dive / sandbox walkthrough (we'll bring runtime engineer + infra lead) — 60 min.
2) Security intake with your SecOps (SSO, data flows, retention) — 30 min.
3) Procurement checklist and POC scope — async, with a short sync if needed.

Can we lock the technical deep dive this week or early next? Below are time slots (PDT):
- Thu 6/25 10:00–11:00
- Thu 6/25 15:00–16:00
- Mon 6/29 09:00–10:00

Marissa (cc) will lead the demo and coordinate materials. If you'd like to loop security/procurement now, add them to reply and we will triage the calendar at that point.

I've attached a short draft agenda for the demo.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page - proposed flow)

Best,
Sean Gallagher

Marissa / Sean — thanks for the checklist. Quick answers and asks before the deep dive:
- Okta is our IdP; we require SP-initiated SSO and a metadata exchange.
- For audit logs we need: user-level request tracing, token lifecycle events, and admin action logs retained for 1 year.
- Please send a short note on how request-level PII is handled in the runtime and whether we can redact or truncate before logs are stored.

If you can email the SSO metadata and the PII-handling note before Thu, we'll review ahead of the demo. Otherwise we can carve out 10 minutes at the top of the demo for alignment.

- Tom
Tom Reed
